subject: Deal-linked GPU slabs and approval ladder for reserved capacity
body:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Liu <anna.liu@cloudwave.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: GPU slab tiers + term options for CloudWave (DEAL-4982)

Anna —

Following up on last week's demo: attached is a compact proposal for reserved capacity that maps to the sizing you shared (peak 12k tokens/sec, expected steady 6k). The key idea is to offer slab-based discounts tied to committed GPU slots and a simple escalation ladder for approvals.

Highlights (see attached XLSX for numbers):
- Slab A (baseline): 8 GPUs reserved — standard discount 10% off list
- Slab B (growth): 16 GPUs reserved — standard discount 18%
- Slab C (scale): 32 GPUs reserved — standard discount 28% with 24-month term option
- Optional indexation buffer: 5% floor to protect both sides if spot GPU market moves >15% year-over-year

Ask: can you confirm whether CloudWave needs an upper bound on monthly burst above the committed slab (we proposed 20% burst at pay-as-you-go pricing) and whether legal needs a vendor-escrow clause?

Attachments: proposed-gpu-slabs-v2.xlsx (numbers & month-by-month cadence), redwood-reserved-term-draft-2026.pdf (term language + pass-through clause).

If this looks reasonable, I'll loop in Finance (Dylan) and Operations (Ben) to confirm approval thresholds and execution steps.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

---

From: Anna Liu <anna.liu@cloudwave.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 13:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: GPU slab tiers + term options for CloudWave (DEAL-4982)

Rachel —

Thanks for the quick turn. A few clarifications from procurement side:

1) We like the slab approach. Our legal will push back on multi-year price reduction triggers unless there's a clear cap. Can you do a symmetric collar: +/- 12% before indexation clause applies?
2) Approval velocity matters. For us to sign by end of month we need a single finance approver at Redwood who can confirm discount authority and a clear path for exceptions.
3) We also want a short canary window (2 weeks) post-activation to validate latency at our p95 loads before full billing ramps.

Can you provide who at Redwood can approve a 20% one-time onboarding discount if needed?

Best,
Anna
Anna Liu
Senior Procurement Manager | CloudWave Inc
anna.liu@cloudwave.com

---

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2026 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: GPU slab tiers + term options for CloudWave (DEAL-4982)

Rachel / Marissa —

Reviewed Anna's asks. Proposed internal approval ladder and sensitivity policy below — this is meant to speed signatures without unnecessary SPOC escalation:

Approval ladder (recommended):
- AE (Rachel): can approve up to 10% unilateral discount on list for 12-mo deals where committed dollars <= $150k ARR equivalent.
- Sales Director (Marissa): can approve up to 25% discount or up to $500k ARR equivalent.
- Finance lead (Dylan): can greenlight up to 35% after margin check and written risk notes (exception to be recorded).
- CRO/CFO (execs): anything >35% or structural pass-throughs/indexation exceptions require executive sign-off.

Indexation & collar:
- We can accept a symmetric +/-12% collar on market index movement for year 1; if movement >12% we default to the proposed 5% floor but reopen pricing conversation at renewal.

Canary / ramp:
- Agree to 2-week canary with reduced billing ramp (50% billed for first week, 100% thereafter) provided CloudWave signs the canary success criteria doc (latency p95 < 220ms and error rate <0.5% under their traffic profile).

Operational asks: Ben, can you validate that we can reserve 32 GPU slots in us-west for a tentative start date of 2026-10-01 and confirm buffer for burst?

I'll draft a short approval memo that Rachel can attach to the DocuSign if CloudWave accepts.

-Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference

---

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Liu <anna.liu@cloudwave.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2026 10:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: GPU slab tiers + term options for CloudWave (DEAL-4982)

Anna —

Thanks — we've spoken internally and can accommodate the symmetric +/-12% collar for year one with the 5% floor fallback thereafter. Dylan's ladder is in place for approvals; quick summary: I can sign up to 10% (should be fine for Slab A pilot), Marissa can handle ups to 25% if you want Slab B, and Finance will sign the rest.

On the canary: we agree to the 2-week window with the criteria Dylan outlined. I'll attach the success criteria template and the revised slab numbers (attached).

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm acceptance of collar + canary in reply.
2) I'll attach the approval memo and send the DocuSign envelope with the redlined term sheet.
3) Ben will confirm infrastructure reservation and launch window.

Attachments: proposed-gpu-slabs-v2.xlsx (updated with a canary line item)

Rachel

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2026 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: GPU slab tiers + term options for CloudWave (DEAL-4982)

Looping in for final run: I approve the proposed ladder and symmetric collar as written.

A couple of operational items before we send:
- Ben, confirm capacity reservation for us-west (32 GPUs) and include a note on lead time for swap to eu-west if CloudWave requests region failover later.
- Dylan, please prep a 1-paragraph margin impact note I can attach to the DocuSign envelope (quick numbers: Blended unit cost with 28% discount still meets target gross margin >40%).
- Rachel, once you get Anna's acceptance I want the DocuSign envelope started (link in related_links). If anything needs exec sign-off (>35% discount) I'll route it, but let's avoid that if possible.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced in thread: proposed-gpu-slabs-v2.xlsx, redwood-reserved-term-draft-2026.pdf
